description: The figure presents two side-by-side horizontal bar charts illustrating inference time (in minutes) for different methods across two models, titled “Marco-o1-7B” (left) and “QwQ-32B-Preview” (right). In both panels, the category axis is vertical (y-axis) with five unlabeled bar positions corresponding to the legend entries, and the value axis is horizontal (x-axis) labeled “Inference Time (minute)” on a linear scale. For “Marco-o1-7B,” the x-axis runs from 0 to 2.5 with tick marks at 0.5 intervals; the bars shown are Baseline (light green) at approximately 2.15 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow) at about 2.10 minutes, SFT (gray) at about 2.10 minutes, DPO (orange) at about 2.10 minutes, and O1-Pruner (blue) at about 1.10 minutes. For “QwQ-32B-Preview,” the x-axis runs from 0 to 7 with tick marks at 1-unit intervals; the bars shown are Baseline (light green) at approximately 6.1 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow) at about 5.0 minutes, SFT (gray) at about 5.8 minutes, DPO (orange) at about 5.6 minutes, and O1-Pruner (blue) at about 4.0 minutes. The bars are color-coded according to the legend (Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, DPO, O1-Pruner), appear as single (non-stacked) bars per method, and there is no visible sorting, highlighting, or numeric annotation on individual bars beyond their lengths against the axis grid.
